title: Sutradhar
_comment: Hand-authored from files/story.md Part 3 timestamps. This is DL3 (the spec slide) and the file the app plays. The annotation agent in director/ must be able to reproduce something equivalent from the raw transcript - that comparison IS the M7 demo.

events.cue: Footsteps overhead. 'Woh aa raha hai... awaaz neeche.'
events.why: The listener must physically lean in. Gain on our own player only - never system volume.

events.cue: Same beat as e1 - the room and the screen recede together.
events.why: Paired with the duck so the world contracts on both senses at once. Never fired alone - a dim with no audio reason is just a dark screen.

events.cue: Under the scene while the footsteps cross and stop.
events.why: Starts 2s after the duck so it reads as her pulse, not as a device buzz. Accelerating pattern carries the 'silence that lasts too long'.

events.cue: CLUNK - the main switch. 'Light gayi. Kuch nahi dikh raha.'
events.why: True dark. Touches blocked; any press >=3s exits (safety).

events.cue: CLICK. Click-click. CLICK - she finds Dada ji's old torch.
events.why: Diegetic: the torch turns on because she found a torch.

events.cue: KNOCK ... KNOCK ... KNOCK on the storeroom door.
events.why: Sync to audio position, not wall clock. +/-50ms or it reads as a bug.

events.cue: 'Woh ab tumhe call karega.' Full-screen incoming call.
events.why: Decision point 1. Missed call is canon, not a failure - Meera has a panic variant.

events.cue: 'Dus second. Koi. Awaaz. Nahi.' - fires AFTER her line ends at 315.8s, not when it starts.
events.why: Measured: her line runs 300->315.8s. Metering at 300 makes the phone hear its own speaker and always take the caught branch. Opens at 317 - 1.2s after she stops - so the mic opens into real silence, and that held beat is the tension.
